item_short_desc: Rothco’s POW-MIA Decal is an outside decal that can be applied to the exterior of any clean, dry surface. The decal measures 3 ¼” by 4 ½” with “You Are Not Forgotten” printed in white lettering and the POW-MIA emblem pictured. The POW-MIA decal is an American symbol of citizen concern about United States military personnel taken as prisoners of war (POWs) or listed as missing in action (MIA).
